name: rack
title: Rack
summary: A bay of instruments: an inset well that holds knobs, faders or meters, named on a raised tab across its top edge.
use: To group the instruments of one processor or effect, as a plugin does: a compressor's dynamics, a clip's color.

options.name: title
options.description: The processor's name, one to three words.

options.name: pages
options.description: With a page binding, the tab steps through pages and dots show where you are.

rules: A rack holds instruments only, never text or forms.
The tab names the processor; the instruments carry their own labels.
accessibility: The rack is a labelled group; pages are announced.
